name: Shi Yu Xun ~The Awaited ReCollection~
source:
The Awaited ReCollection - Shi Yu Xun - is a story about fatherly love, and also familial love.
A gift for those lacking fatherly love in their lives.
"Because you have never had that before, you would said you don't need that."

My long-lost father contacted me, but when I met him, he turned out to be a tiger man.
What had happened in that past? And can I even accept living with a father like this?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2311320/__The_Awaited_ReCollection/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《期待的回忆》《石雨寻》是一个关于父爱，也是亲情的故事。
送给那些生活中缺乏父爱的人的礼物。
“因为你以前从未有过，所以你会说你不需要它。”

失散多年的父亲联系了我，但当我见到他时，他竟然是个虎人。
过去发生了什么？我还能接受和这样的父亲一起生活吗？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2311320/__The_Awaited_ReCollection/]Steam[/url]]
